context: M32 o8. The Flatiron prow, Labor Day night. Lines keyed to the ending (Branch B) and to each lead's resolution.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Made it. Rule seventeen: always end up where you started. Count what changed.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: I parked on the sidewalk. Somebody will give me a ticket. Good. I'll pay it.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Calloway is moving me somewhere safe till the trial. Months. The desk will miss me.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Sunday paper's out. Page nine's on every stoop. Lisle's not answering his phone.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Lisle's stool is mine from Monday. Twelve-forty. Tuna on rye.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: It's ashes. Nobody gets the Tenderloin. Not even me.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Tina's doing hair Monday. My shop. My two chairs.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: My shop opens Monday. One chair empty. Postcard from Philly on the mirror.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: No shop. The club meets Sunday. Same table. Clean count.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: The Corwin belongs to the council now. Mrs. Pruitt sent cookies. Stale.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: The Corwin's mine. New wiring Tuesday. A fan on every floor.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: The Corwin's sold on. October first. I'll be there when they come. I owe her that.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Dusk on Broadway. Same corner. I used to stand right here like a fire hydrant.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Walk with me. Downtown, this time.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Walk with me. Uptown. Like old times. Except it's ours.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Car's here. Back seat. I'll find you, Delphine. I find everybody now.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Delroy's cab line is forty deep tonight. I'll take a shift. Goodnight.
